Rozalimas Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Šiauliai County, Lithuania

Not demolished. Rozalimas's wooden synagogue, built in 1880-81, and the rabbi's house across the road both still stand today — rare physical survivals in this collection. A 1931 fire left many Jewish families homeless, accelerating emigration, particularly to South Africa. After the German occupation in June 1941, Lithuanian nationalists murdered some Jewish neighbors directly; the remaining community was transferred to nearby Pakruojis and murdered there on August 4, 1941, alongside the local Jews. This cemetery was not deliberately destroyed but fell into complete neglect; a 1980s memorial stone here has since had its inscribed plaque stolen.
